verdict.rationale: Docs show a single SDK call (Sandbox.create()) that provisions an isolated sandbox instantly, with 'zero wait time' template startup, plus code execution, filesystem, and networking ready immediately after creation. This is corroborated by consistent quickstart examples across multiple doc pages and a CLI/SDK ecosystem, though there's no independent hands-on benchmark of actual startup latency. Missing for 10: independent/third-party verification of 'seconds' startup time claim beyond vendor docs.
